title: Throughput Economics Roadmap for Dedicated & Hosted
body:
Context:
This is a pragmatic, product-ops facing tracker to align Product, Eng, SRE and Sales on throughput-driven KPI tradeoffs for both Redwood Hosted and Dedicated offerings. The focus is unit economics at scale: per-request latency vs per-token cost vs provisioned capacity efficiency.

Purpose / Goals (short):
- Create a single source of truth for throughput-related KPIs across deployment modes.
- Surface exact thresholds where we recommend switching routing policies (hosted -> dedicated) or enabling autoscale bursts.
- Define rollback/mitigation playbooks tied to KPI triggers.
- Provide handoff checklist for Sales/CS when moving customers from hosted to a Dedicated commitment.

Stakeholders and owners:
- Product ops (owner): Priya Menon (this doc)
- Eng (serving runtime): Liam Chen — kernel tuning & bench artifacts
- SRE / Infra: Marcus Grant — capacity plans & failover policies
- Sales/CS: Sofia Alvarez — commercial/RPO constraints and customer transition playbook

Core KPI grid (source-of-truth values updated weekly — baseline date column on the sheet):
Columns we maintain (one row per customer cohort / traffic profile):
- cohort_id (string)
- traffic_pattern (peak qps / sustained qps / burstiness index)
- avg_token_length
- avg_latency_95_p50 (ms)  -- measured at 95th and 50th percentile
- cost_per_1k_tokens_hosted (USD)
- cost_per_1k_tokens_dedicated (USD)
- cost_delta_percent (hosted -> dedicated)
- capacity_utilization_pct (dedicated pool measure)
- kv_cache_hit_rate_pct
- batching_efficiency_index (0..1)
- sla_tier (free / standard / enterprise)
- recommended_routing (hosted | dedicated | hybrid)
- next_action_owner
- last_data_refresh (YYYY-MM-DD)

Example row (for clarity):
- cohort_id: marketing-bot-alpha
- traffic_pattern: peak 250 qps / sustained 40 qps / high burstiness
- avg_token_length: 120
- avg_latency_95_p50: 480 / 130 ms
- cost_per_1k_tokens_hosted: 0.85
- cost_per_1k_tokens_dedicated: 0.43
- cost_delta_percent: 49%
- capacity_utilization_pct: 72%
- kv_cache_hit_rate_pct: 23%
- batching_efficiency_index: 0.67
- sla_tier: enterprise
- recommended_routing: dedicated (reserve 1.5x sustain)
- next_action_owner: Liam Chen
- last_data_refresh: 2026-03-04

Signal thresholds and action ladder (automated alerts map to these):
1) Cost divergence alert: if cost_delta_percent > 40% AND cohort sustained qps > 30 for 12 hours -> recommend engagement for Dedicated offer (notify Sales + Solutions).
2) Latency SLO breach: if avg_latency_95_p50 > 600 ms (95th) for > 10 minutes -> SRE Paging candidate, start failover to variant with shorter sequence length or quantized model.
3) Capacity saturation: if capacity_utilization_pct > 85% for > 30 minutes -> enable burst autoscaling (if available) OR shift lower-priority traffic to hosted fallback.
4) Cache erosion: kv_cache_hit_rate_pct drops by > 20 percentage points week-over-week -> trigger prompt set review + suggest cache warming for top 50 prefixes.

Routing policy decision rubric (short):
- Candidate for Dedicated: sustained qps > 30 AND cost_delta_percent > 35% AND SLA enterprise or predictable growth runway > 3 months.
- Candidate for Hybrid: burstiness index > 0.6 AND peak qps > 100 but low sustained qps; keep hot path on hosted, steady traffic on Dedicated.
- Stay Hosted: low sustained qps (<10), cost delta < 15%, no strict latency SLA.

Sales handoff checklist (when moving from Hosted trial -> Dedicated discussion):
- Confirm 30-day traffic histogram (SRE)
- Export baseline KPIs from this sheet (Priya)
- Run cost-sim for 3x expected growth (Eng: Liam)
- Proposed reserved capacity spec + autoscale knobs (Marcus)
- Security & compliance requirements check (CS)
